name: iso3
label: Origin (citizenship) ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
construction: special codes: XKX Kosovo, XXS stateless, XXU unknown

name: permits
label: Work permits issued (types A-E)
construction: annual table; NA never occurs (channel exists in all years)

name: declarations
label: Employer declarations registered (entered into the register from 2018)
construction: 0 for origins without access; channel exists from 2007

name: seasonal
label: Seasonal work permits issued
construction: NA before 2018 (channel did not exist); 0 = no documents

name: notifications
label: Notifications of employment of Ukrainian citizens

name: docs_all
label: All documents (four channels)
construction: sum of the channels in operation in the year

name: channel_available_*
label: Channel in operation in the year

name: insured_foreigners
label: Foreigners insured in ZUS at year end

name: insured_ukrainians
label: Ukrainian citizens insured in ZUS at year end

name: decl_access_share
label: Share of the calendar year with access to employer declarations
construction: days in force / days in year

name: eu_visa_free_share
label: Share of the year with EU visa freedom (biometric passports)

name: decl_ever
label: Ever had declaration access (ARM BLR GEO MDA RUS UKR)

name: shock_ua2014
label: Ukraine x year >= 2014
construction: annexation of Crimea and war in Donbas

name: shock_by2021
label: Belarus x year >= 2021
construction: first full year after the 2020 repression

name: flow_recent
label: ln(1 + documents in t-1 to t-3)
construction: documents = permits + declarations + seasonal; NA channels counted as 0

name: flow_older
label: ln(1 + documents in t-4 to t-6)

name: flow_recent_permits
label: ln(1 + permits in t-1 to t-3)

name: ln_presample_mean
label: ln mean permits 2008-2010 (0 if mean is 0)

name: rel_income_l1
label: Relative real income RY(j t-1)
construction: ln I(POL) - ln I(j); I = cumulated real GDP pc growth index, 2006 = 1; lagged one year

name: rel_income_l2
label: Relative real income lagged two years

name: ppp_gap_l1
label: ln(PPP GDP pc Poland / origin) t-1

name: usd_gap_l1
label: ln(current-USD GDP pc Poland / origin) t-1

name: contiguity
label: Shares a land border with Poland

name: baseline
label: In the fixed-effects baseline sample (Table 3 col. 2)
construction: non-missing covariates and not all-zero permits

name: never_eligible
label: Baseline origins never eligible for declarations

name: comparison70
label: Comparison origin for the event studies
